premise: Frog and Snail wish for rain and Butterfly wishes for sun; the rain comes and Butterfly has to hide, so Frog and Snail wish for sun for her — and the sky gives them both, and a rainbow for everyone.
inspiration: The Father and His Two Daughters (Aesop), where one wants rain and the other sun; turned: the friends start wishing for each other, and nobody has to lose.
lesson: A wish for a friend is the best wish.

en-US.title: Frog and the Two Wishes
en-US.text: [curious] What's the best weather? {frog:enter} Frog knew. {frog:hop x2} "Rain! Splishy, splashy rain!" Slowly, {snail:enter} {snail:go to frog} Snail crawled up and nodded. "Too dry out here," he said, {snail:live hide} and hid in his shell. {snail:face happy} "Rain is lovely!" But {butterfly:enter} Butterfly, fluttering by, wasn't so sure. {butterfly:live shake-head} "Sun! Warm, golden sun!" So Frog wished for rain. Snail wished for rain. And Butterfly wished for sun. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter, pitter-patter… down came the rain! {frog:face happy} {frog:live jump} Frog bounced for joy. {snail:live stretch-eyes} Snail stretched out his eye stalks. But Butterfly's wings were getting wet. She flew to the red {mushroom:enter} mushroom, {butterfly:go under mushroom} tucked in under the cap, {butterfly:face sad} {butterfly:live rest hold} and folded her wings. [sad] "Oh dear." Frog looked at Butterfly. {snail:face sad} Snail looked at Butterfly. Then they made a new wish. [whispers] "Sun, please. For our friend." {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} And the rain stopped, and out came the sun. {butterfly:live rest resume} Butterfly opened her wings… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go to sky} and up she fluttered. {canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s} [gasps] Look! The rain and the sun had made a rainbow. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] Everybody's wish, all at once.

es-ES.title: Rana y los dos deseos
es-ES.text: [curious] ¿Qué tiempo es el mejor? {frog:enter} Rana lo tenía clarísimo. {frog:hop x2} —¡La lluvia, que salpica! Despacito, llegó {snail:enter} {snail:go to frog} Caracol, y asintió. —Qué seco está todo —dijo, {snail:live hide} y se metió en su concha. {snail:face happy} —¡La lluvia es lo mejor! Pero {butterfly:enter} Mariposa, que pasaba revoloteando, no lo veía así. {butterfly:live shake-head} —¡Qué va! ¡El sol calentito! Así que Rana pidió lluvia. Caracol pidió lluvia. Y Mariposa pidió sol. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} Plic, ploc, plic, ploc… ¡y se puso a llover! {frog:face happy} {frog:live jump} Rana saltó de alegría. {snail:live stretch-eyes} Caracol estiró los cuernos. Pero a Mariposa se le mojaban las alas. Voló hasta la {mushroom:enter} seta roja, {butterfly:go under mushroom} se metió debajo {butterfly:face sad} {butterfly:live rest hold} y plegó las alas. [sad] —Vaya… Rana miró a Mariposa. {snail:face sad} Caracol miró a Mariposa. Y pidieron otro deseo. [whispers] —Sol, por favor. Para nuestra amiga. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} Y dejó de llover, y salió el sol. {butterfly:live rest resume} Mariposa abrió las alas… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go to sky} y echó a volar. {canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s} [gasps] ¡Mirad! La lluvia y el sol habían pintado un arcoíris. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] El deseo de todos, a la vez.

ja-JP.title: カエルさんと ふたつの おねがい
ja-JP.text: [curious]いちばんすてきなおてんきは？{frog:enter}カエルさんは、しっています。{frog:hop x2}「あめ！ぴちぴち、ちゃぷちゃぷ！」 ゆっくり{snail:enter}{snail:go to frog}カタツムリくんもきて、うんうん。「ここは、かわきすぎ」 と{snail:live hide}からにもぐって、{snail:face happy}「あめが、いちばん！」 でも{butterfly:enter}チョウチョさんは、ちがいました。{butterfly:live shake-head}「おひさまよ！ぽかぽかの！」 ふたりは、あめをおねがい。チョウチョさんは、おひさまを。{canvas:rain 0.7}{sfx:rain}ぽつぽつ…ざあざあ、あめです！{frog:face happy}{frog:live jump}カエルさんは、大よろこび。{snail:live stretch-eyes}カタツムリくんは、つのをにょきっ。でもチョウチョさんは、はねがぬれて、赤い{mushroom:enter}キノコの{butterfly:go under mushroom}かさの下へ。{butterfly:face sad}{butterfly:live rest hold}はねをとじて、[sad]「こまったわ。」 カエルさんは、チョウチョさんを見ました。{snail:face sad}カタツムリくんも。そして、あたらしいおねがい。[whispers]「おひさま、おねがい。ともだちのために。」 {canvas:rain stop}{canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s}あめがやんで、おひさまが！{butterfly:live rest resume}チョウチョさんがはねをひらいて…{butterfly:face happy}{butterfly:go to sky}ひらひら、そらへ。{canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s}[gasps]見て！あめとおひさまが、にじをつくったよ。{all:face happy}{all:hearts}[happily]みんなのおねがい、いっぺんにかなったね。

de-DE.title: Der Frosch und die zwei Wünsche
de-DE.text: [curious] Welches Wetter ist das allerbeste? {frog:enter} Der Frosch wusste es. {frog:hop x2} „Regen! Plitsch-platsch-Regen!“ Langsam kam {snail:enter} {snail:go to frog} die Schnecke herangekrochen und nickte. „Zu trocken hier“, sagte sie {snail:live hide} und verkroch sich. {snail:face happy} „Regen ist herrlich!“ Aber {butterfly:enter} der Schmetterling, der vorbeiflatterte, war anderer Meinung. {butterfly:live shake-head} „Sonne! Warme, goldene Sonne!“ Also wünschte sich der Frosch Regen. Die Schnecke wünschte sich Regen. Und der Schmetterling wünschte sich Sonne. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} Pitsch, patsch, pitsch, patsch… da kam der Regen! {frog:face happy} {frog:live jump} Der Frosch hüpfte vor Freude. {snail:live stretch-eyes} Die Schnecke reckte die Fühler. Aber die Flügel des Schmetterlings wurden nass. Er flog zum roten {mushroom:enter} Pilz, {butterfly:go under mushroom} kuschelte sich unter den Hut {butterfly:face sad} {butterfly:live rest hold} und klappte die Flügel zu. [sad] „Ach je.“ Der Frosch sah den Schmetterling an. {snail:face sad} Die Schnecke auch. Dann wünschten sie sich etwas Neues. [whispers] „Sonne, bitte. Für unseren Freund.“ {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} Der Regen hörte auf, die Sonne kam heraus. {butterfly:live rest resume} Der Schmetterling öffnete die Flügel… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go to sky} und flatterte hinauf. {canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s} [gasps] Schaut! Regen und Sonne hatten einen Regenbogen gemalt. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] Alle Wünsche auf einmal erfüllt.

fr-FR.title: Grenouille et les deux vœux
fr-FR.text: [curious] Quel est le meilleur temps ? {frog:enter} Grenouille le savait. {frog:hop x2} « La pluie ! Plic, ploc, plouf ! » Tout doucement, {snail:enter} {snail:go to frog} Escargot s’est approché : oui, oui ! « Trop sec, ici ! » Et {snail:live hide} il est rentré dans sa coquille. {snail:face happy} « Vive la pluie ! » Mais {butterfly:enter} Papillon n’était pas d’accord. {butterfly:live shake-head} « Le soleil ! Le bon soleil doré ! » Grenouille a fait un vœu : la pluie. Escargot aussi. Et Papillon : le soleil. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} Plic, ploc, plic, ploc… voilà la pluie ! {frog:face happy} {frog:live jump} Grenouille a sauté de joie. {snail:live stretch-eyes} Escargot a allongé ses cornes. Mais Papillon avait les ailes mouillées. Il a volé jusqu’au {mushroom:enter} champignon rouge, {butterfly:go under mushroom} s’est abrité dessous {butterfly:face sad} {butterfly:live rest hold} et a replié ses ailes. [sad] « Oh là là. » Grenouille a regardé Papillon. {snail:face sad} Escargot aussi. Ils ont fait un nouveau vœu. [whispers] « Soleil, s’il te plaît… pour notre ami ! » {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} La pluie a cessé, et le soleil est sorti. {butterfly:live rest resume} Papillon a ouvert ses ailes… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go to sky} et s’est envolé. {canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s} [gasps] Regardez ! La pluie et le soleil avaient fait un arc-en-ciel. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] Tous les vœux, en même temps !

it-IT.title: Rana e i due desideri
it-IT.text: [curious] Qual è il tempo più bello? {frog:enter} Rana lo sapeva bene. {frog:hop x2} «La pioggia! Splish, splash, che bella pioggia!» Piano piano, {snail:enter} {snail:go to frog} Chiocciola si è avvicinata e ha annuito. «Qui è tutto troppo secco», ha detto, {snail:live hide} e si è nascosta nel guscio. {snail:face happy} «La pioggia è bellissima!» Ma {butterfly:enter} Farfalla, che passava svolazzando, non era d'accordo. {butterfly:live shake-head} «Il sole! Il sole caldo e dorato!» Così Rana ha desiderato la pioggia. Chiocciola ha desiderato la pioggia. E Farfalla ha desiderato il sole. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} Plic, ploc, plic, ploc… ed ecco la pioggia! {frog:face happy} {frog:live jump} Rana ha fatto un salto di gioia. {snail:live stretch-eyes} Chiocciola ha allungato i cornini. Ma a Farfalla si bagnavano le ali. È volata fino al {mushroom:enter} fungo rosso, {butterfly:go under mushroom} si è riparata sotto il cappello {butterfly:face sad} {butterfly:live rest hold} e ha chiuso le ali. [sad] «Oh, no…» Rana ha guardato Farfalla. {snail:face sad} Chiocciola ha guardato Farfalla. Poi hanno espresso un desiderio nuovo. [whispers] «Sole, per favore. Per la nostra amica.» {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} La pioggia ha smesso, ed è uscito il sole. {butterfly:live rest resume} Farfalla ha aperto le ali… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:go to sky} ed è volata su. {canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s} [gasps] Guardate! La pioggia e il sole avevano fatto un arcobaleno. {all:face happy} {all:hearts} [happily] Il desiderio di tutti, insieme.

zh-TW.title: 青蛙和兩個願望
zh-TW.text: [curious]什麼天氣最好呢？{frog:enter}青蛙知道。{frog:hop x2}「下雨天！滴滴答答、嘩啦嘩啦的下雨天！」 {snail:enter}{snail:go to frog}蝸牛慢慢爬過來，點點頭。「外面太乾了。」 牠說完，{snail:live hide}縮進殼裡。{snail:face happy}「下雨最棒了！」 可是，飛過來的{butterfly:enter}蝴蝶可不這麼想。{butterfly:live shake-head}「晴天！暖洋洋、金燦燦的大太陽！」 於是，青蛙希望下雨。蝸牛希望下雨。蝴蝶希望出太陽。{canvas:rain 0.7}{sfx:rain}滴滴答答，滴滴答答……下雨了！{frog:face happy}{frog:live jump}青蛙開心得跳起來。{snail:live stretch-eyes}蝸牛把眼睛觸角伸得長長的。可是，蝴蝶的翅膀愈來愈濕。牠飛到紅紅的{mushroom:enter}蘑菇那裡，{butterfly:go under mushroom}躲進菇傘底下，{butterfly:face sad}{butterfly:live rest hold}合起翅膀。[sad]「唉呀……」 青蛙看看蝴蝶。{snail:face sad}蝸牛也看看蝴蝶。於是，牠們許了一個新的願望。[whispers]「太陽，請出來吧。為了我們的好朋友。」 {canvas:rain stop}{canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s}雨停了，太陽出來了。{butterfly:live rest resume}蝴蝶張開翅膀……{butterfly:face happy}{butterfly:go to sky}輕輕飛上天空。{canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s}[gasps]你看！雨和太陽，一起變出了一道彩虹。{all:face happy}{all:hearts}[happily]大家的願望，一下子全都實現了。

zh-HK.title: 青蛙許願
zh-HK.text: [curious]甚麼天氣最好呢？{frog:enter}青蛙最清楚。{frog:hop x2}「落雨！滴滴答答、嘩啦嘩啦咁落雨！」 {snail:enter}{snail:go to frog}蝸牛慢慢爬過來，點點頭。「出面太乾喇。」 牠說完，{snail:live hide}就縮進殼裏。{snail:face happy}「落雨最正！」 可是，飛過的{butterfly:enter}蝴蝶卻不這樣想。{butterfly:live shake-head}「出太陽先好！暖笠笠、金燦燦嘅太陽！」 於是，青蛙希望下雨。蝸牛希望下雨。蝴蝶希望出太陽。{canvas:rain 0.7}{sfx:rain}滴答、滴答，滴答、滴答……下雨了！{frog:face happy}{frog:live jump}青蛙開心得跳了起來。{snail:live stretch-eyes}蝸牛把眼睛觸角伸得長長的。可是，蝴蝶的翅膀愈來愈濕。牠飛到紅色的{mushroom:enter}蘑菇那邊，{butterfly:go under mushroom}躲進蘑菇帽下面，{butterfly:face sad}{butterfly:live rest hold}合起翅膀。[sad]「唉……」 青蛙看看蝴蝶。{snail:face sad}蝸牛也看看蝴蝶。於是，牠們許了一個新的願望。[whispers]「太陽伯伯，唔該你出嚟。為咗我哋嘅好朋友。」 {canvas:rain stop}{canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s}雨停了，太陽出來了。{butterfly:live rest resume}蝴蝶張開翅膀……{butterfly:face happy}{butterfly:go to sky}輕輕飛上天空。{canvas:rainbow 0.8 14s}[gasps]你看！雨和太陽一起，變出了一道彩虹。{all:face happy}{all:hearts}[happily]大家的願望，一下子全都實現了。
